pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 6.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADVERBS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to describe where, when and how events happen?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify adverbs of time, place, and manner in texts
2. use adverbs of time, place, and manner in different contexts

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify adverbs of time, place, and manner in texts
   In simple words: practise until you can identify adverbs of time, place, and manner in texts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. use adverbs of time, place, and manner in different contexts
   In simple words: practise until you can use adverbs of time, place, and manner in different contexts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs.
4. Show that you can: identify adverbs of time, place, and manner in texts

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read a print or non-print text on drug and substance abuse in pairs,
2. Construct sentences using adverbs of time, place, and manner,
3. Use adverbs of time, place, and manner in a role play, hot seating or simulation and make a video recording,
4. Critical thinking and problem solving: It is enhanced as the learner thinks of different ways of describing manner, time, and place.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify adverbs of time, place, and manner in texts
2. use adverbs of time, place, and manner in different contexts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
